title: Recalibrate triage after estimate-total fix
acceptance: Root cause and the calibration choice recorded in the result and per ADR-003
brief: S3-AI-01 fixed estimate extraction (grand total now includes parts+labor+tax instead of the parts subtotal). Since then auto_rear_end_injury (both tenants) triages "severe" where the scenario expects "major". Per ADR-003 decide: tune the estimate-amount contribution in triage severity (likely the dollar weight or cut-off was calibrated against the wrong, lower total) or change the expectation with a one-line rationale. Prefer tuning, since a towed rear-end with soft-tissue injury is major, not severe. Keep every other scenario passing.

verdicts.reason: e2e, triage unit, e2e+security gate pass with no new failures; root cause and ADR-003 tuning recorded; scenario expectations unchanged
